svg.title: PLC RS485 termination switch location
svg.desc: The three switches beside the Ethernet ports are RS485, RS422 and CAN from left to right in this photo. The first switch, marked RS485, connects the 120 ohm termination resistor when moved down. The photo shows its location, not a required initial state.
svg.text: Find the RS485 switch beside the Ethernet ports. Move it down to connect 120 Ω.
Set with PLC power off. This switch controls termination; software controls baud rate and TXEN.
